IS : 9388 ( Part I ) - 1979 



Indian Standard 



( Reaffirmed 2002 ) 




SPECIFICATION FOR 

EQUAL ELBOW BODY FOR 

OIL-HYDRAULIC COUPLINGS 

PART I MADE FROM FORGINGS 



1- Scope — Specifies the dimensions, material and other requirements for equal elbow body made 
from forgings for use in oil-hydraulic systems. 

2. Dimensions— Shall be as given in Table 1. 

3. Material —Steel according to Class 1A of IS : 1875-1978 'Specification for carbon steel billets, 
blooms, slabs and bars for forgings (fourth revision )' or any other steel as agreed to between the 
user and the manufacturer. 

4. Surface Protection — Elbow bodies are to be phosphated according to Class A2 of IS : 3618-1966 
'Specification for phosphate treatment of iron and steel for protection against corrosion 1 , unless 
otherwise agreed to between the user and the manufacturer. 

5. General Requirements 

5.1 These elbow bodies are intended for assembly in accordance with Type C of IS : 9411-1980 
1 Specification for elbow coupling assemblies for oil-hydraulic systems \ 

5.2 For details not covered in this standard, reference shall be made to IS : 8805 ( Part I )-1978 
1 General requirements for ferrule type couplings used in oil-hydraulic systems: Part I General \ 

6. Designation — An equal elbow body of light series L for outside diameter of tube 6 mm and 
conforming to this standard shall be designated as : 

Equal Elbow Body L6 IS : 9388 ( Part I ) 



EXPLANATORY NOTE 

This standard covers elbow bodies made from forgings only. The elbow bodies made from 
bar stock are covered in IS : 9388 (Part II )-1979 'Specification for equal elbow body for oil- 
hydraulic couplings: Part II Made from bar stock \ 

In the preparation of this standard, assistance has been derived from the following 

standards: 

BS 4368 Specification for carbon and stainless steel compression couplings for tubes: Part I 
Heavy series (metric), and Part 3 Light series (metric). 

DIN 3905 Non-soldered taper bush type pipe unions, elbow for use with union nut. 



Adopted 19 December 1979 



March 1980, ISI
